_comment: Books to seed (Storage::upsert_book) before importing each synthetic fixture. Sidecars without a sibling .epub match the library by fuzzy title, so the title here must match the fixture's doc_props.title. Fixtures with an empty books list are expected to stay unmatched. A book may also carry isbn_10/isbn_13/language; `expect.match_via` ('isbn' or 'title') is asserted against BookImportStats.matched_by, which is the only thing guarding the sibling-epub ISBN branch — fuzzy title matching would otherwise silently rescue it. `Gen-*` fixtures are written by `cargo run -p corpus -- gen-synthetic`.

Gen-Isbn-Match.sdr._note: The seeded title is deliberately nothing like the sidecar's doc_props.title, so a match can ONLY come from the sibling epub's ISBN.

Gen-Pdf-Sidecar.sdr._note: Covers the sidecar file NAME (metadata.pdf.lua), not PDF-shaped contents — its annotations are cre xpointers. Gen-Pdf-Anchors is the contents case.

Gen-Pdf-Anchors.sdr._note: pos0 is a TABLE (page + coordinates), which is what KOReader writes on a paging document. Nothing imports; the golden's `warnings` must name SidecarAnchorsUnsupported with a count of 3 — the bookmark at [4] is not one of them. A golden that merely showed zero highlights would be the bug written down.

Gen-Summary-Unknown-Status.sdr._note: An unrecognised status must import cleanly and warn, never fail. `has_warnings` in the golden is the assertion.
